name: CircularText-TS-TW
blurb: Text letters orbit in a circle, speeding up or pausing on hover.
description: Arranges text letters around a circle and rotates them continuously. On hover, responds with adjustable behaviors: speed up, slow down, pause, or spin wildly.
use_when: A playful, interactive logo or decoration that draws attention through constant motion.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or pages where vestibular motion may cause discomfort — no reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Text is laid out as individual letters in rotated spans; not linearized for screen readers. No keyboard interaction.
